query:
INSERT INTO read_states (user_id, article_id, is_starred, starred_at, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(user_id, article_id) DO UPDATE SET
                is_starred = 1,
                starred_at = excluded.starred_at,
                updated_at = excluded.updated_at
